episodes.title: This Is What Happens
episodes.summary: After losing his high-powered job, Coop attends a neighbor's barbecue, where he faces his ex-wife Mel—and makes a surprising choice.

episodes.title: Deuce
episodes.summary: After an unsuccessful job interview, Coop pawns a stolen watch.

episodes.title: Theoretical Herpes
episodes.summary: Nick throws a party for the neighborhood men, leading to tension between Coop and Paul. The women take a self-defense class.

episodes.title: Literal Dragons
episodes.summary: An unlikely alliance begins. Nick throws Mel a surprise birthday party, where she connects with Coop.

episodes.title: This Tourist Has Balls
episodes.summary: Coop and Elena sell a stolen painting. Barney tries to hide his financial struggles from his in-laws. Coop makes a discovery at Sam's home.

episodes.title: The Things You Lost Along the Way
episodes.summary: After being investigated, Coop sets off on a college tour with Mel and their kids while Elena attempts to get ahold of him.

episodes.title: The First Honest Thing
episodes.summary: Detective Lin makes a discovery at the crime scene. Coop plays hardball with Kat. Chivo puts Elena in a tough spot.

episodes.title: When Did We Become These People?
episodes.summary: Coop tries getting back what he's lost. Mel and Sam clash. Coop, Nick, and Barney have a boys' night.

episodes.title: Everything Becomes Symbol and Irony
episodes.summary: Season finale. Coop fights for his freedom.

episodes.title: We're Here Until We're Not
episodes.summary: The arrival of a charming billionaire neighbor disrupts Westmont Village. Coop finds himself with an unexpected new partner in crime.

episodes.title: Lady Bits
episodes.summary: A surprise party for Tori goes awry, causing a rift in the Cooper family. Sam struggles with her alienation from the community.

episodes.title: We Were Never Supposed to Get This Old
episodes.summary: Ashe offers Coop a deal he can't refuse. Mel feuds with her neighbors over their new dog. Sam goes on a date.

episodes.title: The Bread of Affliction
episodes.summary: Hari and Gretchen's Passover seder brings the neighborhood together for wine, food, and drama.

episodes.title: Halfway to Invisible
episodes.summary: Barney deals with Ashe's audit of Nick's Strong Ass Gym. Coop and Jack travel overseas to woo a big investor. Nick throws a housewarming party.

episodes.title: For Everything Else, There Was Bowling
episodes.summary: Coop and his family navigate a fraught funeral service and wake.

episodes.title: Out East
episodes.summary: Coop and Sam attend a wild weekend at Ashe's Hamptons estate. Mel takes things too far in her battle with the neighbors.

episodes.title: I Feel Lost Without Me
episodes.summary: Mel and Tori face the consequences of their actions. Sam tries to end things with Ashe. Coop is caught between a rock and a hard place.

episodes.title: Propaganda from the Cowardly
episodes.summary: Alliances are tested when Coop, Barney, and Nick attend a dinner at Ashe's mansion.

episodes.title: The Night of the Hunter
episodes.summary: Season finale. In the wake of another shocking scandal, the neighborhood gathers for Father's Day at the country club.
